pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 60 °C·d above 10 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1600 °C·d$(). Best near 30 °C; stops above 42 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below 2 °C (5 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5.5-7 (tolerates 4.5-8). Roots 0.5 m. Survives flooding.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 100, P 20, K 110 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 40 cwt/ac (4.5 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Paddy Rice.
